breakdown.description: Hydraulic jump is asserted for subcritical upstream flow (Fr1=0.5), which contradicts the condition Fr1>1 for a jump.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification changed the upstream Froude number from the incorrect Fr1=0.5 (subcritical) to Fr1=2.0 (supercritical), which matches the ground truth and satisfies the physical requirement Fr1>1 for a hydraulic jump to occur.
